verdict.rationale: Vanta's docs describe continuous/automated monitoring and reminders (e.g., docs-22, docs-45, docs-49) as built-in platform behavior, and offer webhooks for event-driven notifications instead of polling (docs-4), but there is no evidence of an API, MCP tool, or workflow feature that lets an AI-native user programmatically define or schedule custom recurring jobs/workflows. Missing for 10: a scheduling/cron API or workflow-orchestration endpoint, MCP tool for creating recurring automations, and any documentation of user-configurable recurring job definitions.
